task: Fix the systemic CI flake diagnosed in selected-paper-flake-diagnosis-20260915.json: sequence the two concurrent CPU-bound record-sheet render pipelines (Atlas's stalled print, Locust's fresh preview) in e2e/customizer-record-sheet-rendering.spec.ts by settling Locust's own render before releasing the stalled print pips.
base_sha_note: origin/main HEAD at fetch time (commit: spec(openspec): ledger and tasks reconciliation batch 3 ... (#1736))
commit_message_subject: test(e2e): settle the Locust render before releasing the stalled print pips

diff.location: inside the try block of the 'Print writes one current sheet into the reserved window at the selected paper @customizer' test, immediately after `await loadLocustBesideAtlas(page);` (line 354) and before the `finally { releasePips(); }` block (lines 355-357)

code_reading_confirmation.helpers_read: e2e/customizer-record-sheet-rendering.spec.ts lines 77-205 (loadLocustBesideAtlas, waitForBacking, latestSheetSvg, sheetTypeName, expectSheetType) plus the critical section lines 322-372
code_reading_confirmation.waitForBacking: lines 138-145: `async function waitForBacking(page, size) { await expect.poll(async () => backingSize(page)).toEqual({ width: size.backingWidth, height: size.backingHeight }); }` -- polls the preview canvas's actual backing-store pixel size against the expected paper size until it matches (proves the preview canvas has re-rendered at the new size).
code_reading_confirmation.expectSheetType: lines 201-205: `async function expectSheetType(page, name) { await expect.poll(async () => sheetTypeName(await latestSheetSvg(page))).toBe(name); }` -- polls the most recently captured SVG blob's embedded '<... id="type">' text until it matches the expected unit type name (proves the newly-loaded unit's own SVG has been captured, not a stale one).
code_reading_confirmation.loadLocustBesideAtlas: lines 77-94: clicks 'Add unit', selects canonical, searches/filters for 'Locust LCT-1V', clicks Load Unit, waits for the dialog to close, switches to the Preview tab, and waits for the zoom label to be visible. Does NOT itself wait for the record-sheet render to complete -- confirmed no polling on canvas/SVG state inside this helper, which is exactly why a caller-side settle is needed after it.
code_reading_confirmation.releasePips: a local Promise-resolver captured in the test body (not a helper in recordSheetPrintHarness.ts): `let releasePips!: () => void; const heldPips = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releasePips = resolve; });`. The route handler on '**/record-sheets/biped_pips/**' (times: 1) awaits `heldPips` before calling `route.continue()`, so calling `releasePips()` in the `finally` block is what unblocks Atlas's stalled print pipeline.
code_reading_confirmation.sequencing_confirmed: The inserted `await waitForBacking(page, LETTER); await expectSheetType(page, 'Locust LCT-1V');` runs BETWEEN `loadLocustBesideAtlas(page)` (line 354, kicks off Locust's CPU-bound preview render) and the `finally` block's `releasePips()` (line 356, which unblocks Atlas's stalled print pipeline) -- so Locust's preview must fully settle to its final backing size and correct SVG type BEFORE Atlas's print is allowed to resume, eliminating the window in which both CPU-bound render pipelines could run concurrently.
code_reading_confirmation.precedent_match: waitForBacking is the identical predicate (same function, same LETTER constant) used by the same-day commit 9b59a19f8/79de4f195's settle pattern already present at spec.ts:305-308 in the earlier 'preview shows the last requested unit...' test: `await waitForBacking(page, LETTER); await loadLocustBesideAtlas(page); await waitForBacking(page, LETTER); await expectSheetType(page, 'Locust LCT-1V');` -- the fix in this task reuses that exact waitForBacking+expectSheetType pair at the one remaining unsettled tab-switch point the diagnosis identified.
